text: Training Objectives This major has the basic knowledge and basic skills in basic medicine, clinical medicine and anesthesiology. It can be used in the anesthesiology, emergency department, emergency center, ICU, drug dependence abstinence and pain diagnosis and treatment in the medical and health unit from the clinical anaesthesia, first aid and resuscitation, and postoperative monitoring. Senior medical professionals who work in the regulation of physiology and physiology. Requirements 1. Master basic theories and basic knowledge of basic medicine, clinical medicine and anesthesiology; 2. Grasp the dialectical thinking and analytical methods of clinical diagnosis and treatment; 3. It has the primary ability of diagnosis and treatment of common diseases, multiple diseases and pain. It has the basic ability of common operation anesthesia, prevention and control of perioperative complications and monitoring, judgment and treatment of critical diseases; 4. The basic ability of first aid and life resuscitation; 5. Familiar with national health policy, policies and regulations; 6. Mastering the basic methods of document retrieval, data inquiry, computer application and statistical analysis, and have certain scientific research and practical working ability. Main subjects Basic Medicine, clinical medicine and anesthesiology. Main courses: human anatomy, physiology, pharmacology, internal medicine, surgery, clinical anesthesiology, emergency medicine, pain diagnosis and treatment, anesthetic pharmacology, anesthesia equipment, anesthesia physiology, anesthesia anatomy. Duration: 3 years
